mentions.name: Old Agent
mentions.description: A sysadmin agent that runs AI on machines up to 30 years old, written entirely in legacy Perl. It supports legacy operating systems such as HP-UX, OpenStep, Solaris 8, Tru64, Irix, old Linux, legacy FreeBSD, and NetBSD, includes an optional Tk desktop interface, and ships a proxy for modern TLS connectivity.
